name: TTW Public Company Limited
summary: TTW Public Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the production and sale of treated water in Thailand. The company supplies water to the Provincial Waterworks Authority in the Amphur Nakorn Chaisri, Amphur Sam Pran, and Amphur Budha Monthon areas of Nakhon Pathom; and Amphur Muang and Amphur Kratumban areas of Samut Sakhon. It also provides water treatment and maintenance services to Provincial Waterworks; manages wastewater treatment systems; and operates and maintains water supply projects.
